name: finsolenterprises
description: Finsol Enterprises: unclaimed investment and IEPF share recovery platform (web, API, database, shared domain).

scripts.build: npm run build -w @finsol/shared && npm run build -w @finsol/db && npm run build -w @finsol/api && npm run build -w @finsol/web
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @finsol/shared && npm run build -w @finsol/db
scripts.test: npm test -w @finsol/shared && npm test -w @finsol/db && npm test -w @finsol/api
